subject: Loop heartbeat: exclude unwired tasks from spawn, surface wire directive, steer 409 to request_guidance
description:
Close the unwired-task livelock in /Users/imyu/Desktop/zonoid daemon.js. Today decideOne (~lines 636-735) has zero awareness of the unwired quarantine: an unwired task still reads `ready`, so the loop spawns a worker → start_task 409s → worker dies or falsely mark_roots → task stays ready → respawned next heartbeat. Token-burning livelock with no transit back to the dispatcher tier.

Three changes:
1. decideOne spawn-set filter: when computing the `ready` list to spawn, EXCLUDE tasks flagged in the overlay's `unwired` map (ov.unwired[key]). Never hand a worker a task it cannot claim.
2. Surface the excluded tasks in the decision payload: add a `wire: [{key, label}]` field to the returned decision object (on spawn AND idle actions) listing unwired ready tasks, so the loop-driving dispatcher wires them (suggest_links + add_dependency, or mark_root for true roots) before they become spawnable. Daemon stays dumb — it only reports the flag it already computes; the dispatcher judges.
3. Reword the 409 at daemon.js ~line 2203 (unwired claim refusal) to steer WORKER agents up, not sideways: error should say roughly 'task is unwired — if you are a worker agent, call request_guidance to escalate to your dispatcher (do NOT mark_root to unblock yourself); if you created this task, add_dependency to wire it or mark_root only if it is a true standalone root'.

Also update skills/orch-loop/SKILL.md: document the new `wire` field — when a decision carries wire[], the loop driver must wire those tasks (suggest_links + add_dependency / mark_root with judgment) before the next tick.

Tests: find the existing loop-decision tests (test/capacity-fill.test.js exercises decideOne spawn batching; check also sweep.test.js / loop-related tests for harness conventions). Add coverage: an unwired ready task is NOT in the spawn list AND appears in wire[]; after add_dependency clears the flag it becomes spawnable. Run those suites + node --check daemon.js.

CAUTION: working tree has uncommitted changes from sibling tasks in daemon.js (unhandledRejection handler, graceful shutdown, compactGraphStores), lib/graph-store.js, scripts/run-tests.js, package.json, .github/. A test-fixing agent (task /6) may also have touched lib files and tests. Re-read current file state before editing; minimal diffs; do not revert anything. Do NOT restart the live daemon; do NOT git commit.
